{{EnemiesAppearing|Super Metal Hippoe|Sir Metal Seal|Metal One Horn|Metal Hippoe|Metal Cyclone}} '''Attack on Titanium (Insane)''' is the 5th [[:Category:Cyclone Stages|Cyclone Stage]]. It was added in [[Version 3.0 Update|Version 3.0]] and appears every Sunday. Upon completion, players have a 30% chance to unlock [[Hoop Cat (Rare Cat)|Hoop Cat]]. {{Stage Info |stage name = [[File:rc021.png]] [[File:Mapsn043 00 s en.png]] |stage location = [[File:Mapname043 s en.png]] |energy = 200 |catamins = [[Catamin]] [A] x2 |enemy castle hp = 400,000 HP |enemies = {{Magnification|Super Metal Hippoe|100% |Sir Metal Seal|100% |Metal One Horn|100% |Metal Hippoe|100%}} |boss = {{Magnification|Metal Cyclone|100%}} |treasure = - [[Hoop Cat (Rare Cat)|Hoop Cat]] (30%, 1 time) |XP = 3,800 XP |width = 3,600 |max enemies = 2 |jpname = Advancing Steel Scrap Super Extreme |script = 進撃の鉄屑 超激ムズ |romaji = Shingeki no Tetsukuzu Chōgeki Muzu |star = 1 |event-chapter = Sweet Irony |difficulty = ★5 |prev stage = N/A |next stage = N/A }} ==Battleground== *Infinite [[Super Metal Hippoe]]s spawn after 233.33 seconds7,000f, delay 66.67~80 seconds2,000f~2,400f. *1 [[Sir Metal Seal]] spawns after 200 seconds6,000f. *1 [[Metal One Horn]] spawns after 166.67 seconds5,000f. *1 [[Super Metal Hippoe]] spawns after 133.33 seconds4,000f. *1 [[Metal Hippoe]] spawns after 100 seconds3,000f. *When the base reaches 90% HP: **1 [[Metal Cyclone]] spawns as the boss. ==Strategy== Metal Cyclone is the most durable [[:Category:Metal Enemies|Metal]] enemy in the game, so [[:Category:Critical Hit Cats|Critical Hitters]] are a must. It is recommended to beat some other [[:Category:Cyclone Stages|Cyclone Stages]] first, as they provide additional [[:Category:Anti-Metal Cats|anti-Metal units]] that greatly ease the fight. It is recommended to use Critical Hitters who can outrange [[Super Metal Hippoe]], such as [[Space Cat (Rare Cat)|Major Space Cat]], as this will make landing [[Critical Hit|Crits]] on him significantly easier. Critters with hard hitting, fast or guaranteed Critical attacks such as [[Jurassic Cat (Rare Cat)|Jurassic Cat]] and [[Sunny Neneko (Super Rare Cat)|Seaside Neneko]] can be very useful, though do be wary of the low range that most have. Because this stage has an enemy limit of 2, it is theoretically cheesable by using Knockback-Immune units to pin the Super Metal Hippoe and Metal Hippoe at the base, preventing them from advancing while others chip away at the base, destroying it without confronting the Metal Cyclone. ==='''Recommended Units'''=== *[[Jurassic Cat (Rare Cat)|Catasaurus/Jurassic Cat Sitter]] - Able to consistently deal critical hits with proper support. This cat can also be paired with other critical hitters to keep the metal enemies away from your base and deal decent amounts of damage to said enemies. *[[Sunny Neneko (Super Rare Cat)|Seaside Neneko]] - This cat can deal a significant amount of damage to whatever is hit by her attack with her guaranteed critical hit. *[[Bronze Cat (Rare Cat)|Michelangelo Cat]] - This cat can be used to keep metal enemies at a safe distance and allow you other cats to deal critical hits. *[[Space Cat (Rare Cat)|Major Space Cat]] - This cat has a reliable critical chance and long range, allowing him to stay at a safe distance and be stacked to help build a large amount of damage to anything within his range in case of a critical hit. *[[Cheerleader Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Cheerleader Cat]] - She has a guaranteed and hard-hitting critical hit at high levels, making her great for dealing damage to the Cyclone and Sir Metal Seal, but she is locked behind a [[Unholy Tempest (Insane)|fairly difficult stage]]. *[[Backhoe Cat (Super Rare Cat)|Power Backhoe Cat]] - A below average critter, but if you pair this unit with [[Li'l Fish Cat (Special Cat)|Li'l Whale Cat]] you get +1% added to all of your unit's critical chances with their [[Whale Digger (Combo)|combo.]] This mostly benefits fast critters like Catasaurus. ==='''Recommended Ubers'''=== *[[Marauder Cat (Uber Rare Cat)|Berserker Cat]] - Similar to Cheerleader Cat, but instead deals about 5000 damage with a 40% critical hit chance and a faster attack rate. *[[Kyosaka Nanaho (Legend Rare Cat)|Kyosaka Nanaho]] - Able to deal extremely high-damage critical hits with an above-average range and a 50% chance to deal a critical hit. Additionaly, she can also survive a fatal blow, allowing her to continue dealing critical hits from a safe distance. Be wary of her blindspot though, as if too many enemies reach this blindspot, she could easily be killed and your frontlines might be left vulnerable. *[[Agent Staal (Uber Rare Cat)|Edgemaster Staal]] - Low critical hit chance, but attacks extremely rapidly and can slow metals, can deal 15,300 damage at level 30. ==Missions== {{MissionTable |{{Mission|Cyclone Festival Missions
Clear the "Sweet Irony" stage!|+1000000 XP(s)|xp|type = special}} |{{Mission|Cyclone Festival Missions
Clear "Sweet Irony" 1 times using 8 or more Rare Cats.|3 [[Catseye]] [Super Rare](s)|supereye|type = special}} }} ==Walkthrough== {{Walkthrough |3T2x6lwFhGU|Uriboten| |BsivyrQrIdI|Mint|Cheese }} ==Schedule== ===English Version=== *This stage appeared for the first time on March 24th, 2015. *This stage will appear every Sunday thereafter. ===Japanese Version=== *This stage appears every Sunday. *December 28th, 2014 to January 1st, 2015 (first time) ==Trivia== *Attack on Titanium is a pun on the manga and anime [[wikipedia:Attack on Titan|''Attack on Titan'']] and the metallic element [[wikipedia:Titanium|titanium]]. *Sweet Irony's Japanese name, Tetsuko no Heya (鉄子の部屋, "Tetsuko's Room"), is a reference to ''[https://mydramalist.com/38667-tetsuko-s-room Tetsuko's Room]''(徹子の部屋), a long-running talk show hosted by [[wikipedia:Tetsuko Kuroyanagi|Tetsuko Kuroyanagi]]. The joke is that instead of 徹, the event's name spells ''tetsu'' using 鉄, the kanji for iron. *The title of the chapter "Sweet Irony" is a pun, where Iron-y references the metal enemies present in the stage. It is also a reference to how you receive an anti-metal cat from defeating a stage that requires anti-metal cats, hence the word Irony ==Reference== *https://battlecats-db.com/stage/s01043-01.html {{Cyclone}} [[Category:Event Stages]]
